subphase: B45 structural resolution: the nine zero-argument cleanup thunks are safe

summary.statement: The nine B45 cleanup thunks take no arguments and only call engine_table_cleanup over static slots. They are safe extern fns at S4 with compile-time controls. The C5 refusal recorded in b45-c5-review-2026-11-13.json is preserved, but it now blocks no live unsafe-fn obligation. A re-census is required before the applied review-required count drops from 98 to a projected 70.
